source: Muse recheck of first-pass flags; apply through the belt (02 fact block -> 16 -> 04/05 remint), never in place

corrections.corrected_statement: Montana makes the driver responsible for ensuring occupants are properly belted or secured in child safety seats, subject to the listed legal exceptions.
corrections.note: Driver responsibility is on page 29 but the exceptions are listed on page 30.

corrections.corrected_statement: A dead signal and a flashing red light both demand a stop-sign style stop, while a flashing yellow light on the same page asks only for cautious movement.
corrections.note: Dead-signal and flashing-red rules are on page 40 while flashing-yellow caution is on page 41.

corrections.corrected_statement: Yield to vehicles already in the roundabout because they have the right of way over entering traffic.
corrections.note: Removed all-way stop comparison that no provided page states.

corrections.corrected_statement: Never pass or overtake another vehicle after entering a single lane roundabout.
corrections.note: Removed claim about passing rules outside the circle.

corrections.corrected_statement: Drivers who are not in a funeral procession must yield to procession vehicles and must not drive between moving procession vehicles unless authorized by a police officer or driving an emergency vehicle and must not join the procession to gain its right of way and must not pass the procession on the right on a multiple lane highway unless the procession is in the farthest left lane and must not enter an intersection through a red light while the procession is proceeding unless entering without crossing the path of the procession.
corrections.note: Added the missing exceptions for authorized splitting and for passing on the right and entering on red.

corrections.corrected_statement: Many bicyclists under age fifteen have not taken a bicycle safety course or driving test so they do not know many road rules and drivers should use extra caution around youngsters on bikes.
corrections.note: Removed the added claim that trained riders are expected to know the rules.

corrections.corrected_statement: Vehicles parked on a roadway or shoulder during hours of darkness must have front and rear lights visible for five hundred feet and any headlights that are on must be dimmed.
corrections.note: Removed the added claim that day parking needs no lights.

corrections.corrected_statement: Texting is the most alarming distraction because it involves simultaneous manual visual and cognitive distraction.
corrections.note: Removed unsupported comparison that other distractions load fewer channels.
